results.title: Housing Society Can Fix Maintenance, But Must Pass On BMC Property Tax Concession: Court
results.description: Mumbai Co-op Court says societies can fix maintenance but must apply BMC property-tax concessions to eligible individual tenements. The post Housing Society Can Fix Maintenance, But Must Pass On BMC Property Tax Concession: Court appeared first on Square Feat India .

results.title: When will the final voter roll of Delhi’s SIR be published?
results.description: The Election Commission has pushed back Delhi’s SIR schedule again, with the draft voter roll now due on August 31 and the final electoral roll on November 4.
